# parity-fuzz --mode nest baseline: normalized signatures of KNOWN gaps.
# A divergence whose signature is here is allowed; a NEW one fails CI.
# Regenerate: parity-fuzz --mode nest --count N --verify 3  (copy NEW-signature lines).
#
# KNOWN GAP: inside `"…"`, a nested expansion whose inner applies a SET OPERATOR
# (`:|` difference, `:*` intersection) still evaluates the operator, where zsh
# discards it along with the outer join:
#
#   a=(one two three four); b=(two four six eight)
#   print -r -- "${(j:,:)${a:|b}}"  -> zsh:   [one two three four]   (both dropped)
#                                      zshrs: [one,three]
#
# Pre-existing (identical at HEAD before the DQ scalar-context work) and NOT the
# same bug as the (o)/(q)/(U) inner-flag collapse, which is now fixed: a bare
# array PARAM collapses to a scalar in DQ, while an array MANUFACTURED by a
# split / set op / filter survives. zsh apparently drops the set op entirely in
# this shape; that needs its own investigation against Src/subst.c:3456-3520.
#
# UNQUOTED forms match.
  print -r -- "[${${#${(L)m}}//o/0}]"
  print -r -- "[${${${(L)m}[2]}#*_}]"
  print -r -- "[${${${(O)path}[2]}#*_}]"
  print -r -- "[${${${(U)a}[2]}#*_}]"
  print -r -- "[${${${(U)m}[2]}//o/0}]"
  s=Hello_World; t=a:b:c:d; path=/usr/local/bin/zsh; lines=$'aa\nbb\ncc'; a=(one two three four); nums=(3 1 4 1 5); typeset -A m; m=(k1 v1 k2 v2); ptr=s; empty='';
